speaker: richard_burbage
text: Take it before I lean on it. The paint is gone off the hilt.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Let me see. A lath sword, and worn to the grain.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: It killed four Richmonds. Tell the boy.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will tell him when I put it in his hand. That is not this week. It is mine to carry, and it is not his yet.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: A lath sword will not suffer a real blow. It has suffered four on a stage, which is better service.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then it has earned the walk to Stratford.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Point down in the street, Will. It has killed quite enough Richmonds for one piece of lath.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Point down. Thank you for the sword.
